title: public/app local conventions: AGENTS.md files, extensions import boundary, manual reducer wiring, SafeDynamicImport
answers: Why can't I import JourneyTrackerImpl directly?
Why does eslint block importing from app/extensions?
Are route components lazy-loaded in public/app?
What conventions should I follow when editing public/app?
body: Nested `AGENTS.md` files under `public/app` are load-bearing (not decorative), e.g. `public/app/features/AGENTS.md`, `public/app/core/journeys/AGENTS.md` (says: don't import `JourneyTrackerImpl`/`JourneyRegistryImpl` directly, use `@grafana/runtime` hooks instead), `public/app/features/alerting/unified/AGENTS.md`. ESLint `no-restricted-imports` blocks importing anything from `app/extensions/*` outside of `public/app/extensions/**` (enterprise hook point isolation). Route components in `public/app/routes/routes.tsx` are almost universally wrapped in `SafeDynamicImport` for code-splitting; a plain static import there is the exception, not the norm. Root reducer composition (`public/app/core/reducers/root.ts`) is manual, see cochange note on adding features.
applies: Applies to code under public/app/; the extensions import boundary specifically applies to anything importing from app/extensions/* from outside that directory.
